sources.supports: Six stat names and armor archetype combinations; 125% active ability cooldown bonus. It does not establish the community curve coefficients.
Existing grenade/melee passive and chunk curve coefficients; unchanged by this migration.

implementation.consumers: Ability effects select source-scoped arcbolt_energy_scaling/threaded_spike_energy_scaling, querying derived attributes with explicit zero input. No stat Buff needs to be initialized.
implementation.intrinsic_input: Optional grenade_stat/melee_stat Buff points now contribute to attribute profiles only. Supply intrinsic points excluding equipment to avoid double counting.
implementation.armor: armor_stats bundle supplies six typed stat contributions; character_stats sums each profile then clamps 0..200. Five-slot test item schema passes explicit physical gear values.

limits: Armor stat input bounds 0..200 are a synthetic representation constraint, not a Destiny drop distribution or validated total budget.
Physical helmet/arms/chest/legs/class item inputs are tested; full production item catalogue, class restrictions, archetypes and mods remain incomplete.
Health/Class/Super/Weapons attributes are queryable; full native gameplay consumers are not added by this migration.
Arcbolt grenade selections and cross-subclass combinations in fixtures remain synthetic; only Threaded Spike has the existing explicit calibrated action prototype.
Original formulas and per-point precision are not remeasured; existing CES and fitted curve saturation at 100 remain unchanged.

Historical armor-energy.json used gviz array coordinates; fresh explicit-range queries place passive samples at D9:N9 and active bonus samples at D10:N10. Use the new range references for original-sheet coordinates.

source_conflicts.comparison: Official June 4 ability update states maximum active bonus 125%; fresh explicit-range Engineeeer Armor Stat Info N10 equals 1.25.
source_conflicts.decision: Retain existing separately fitted +125% chunk curve, mark Compendium text conflict unresolved. This migration makes no new numerical calibration claim.
